lines.say: I've been waiting twenty minutes for one coffee! This is ridiculous!
lines.zh: 一杯咖啡我等了二十分鐘！太誇張了吧！

lines.say: It's not my fault! The machine is broken!
lines.zh: 又不是我的錯！機器壞了！

lines.say: Everything I said was true. The machine was broken. It wasn't my fault.
lines.zh: 我說的都是真的。機器壞了，也不是我的錯。

lines.say: And the customer got angrier, asked for my manager, and wrote a one-star review about me.
lines.zh: 結果客人更火大，要求找經理，還寫了一顆星評論罵我。

board.cta: 客人生氣了怎麼辦・12 句

lines.say: Hi everyone, I'm Neev! Today: twelve sentences for when a customer is angry.
lines.zh: 哈囉大家，我是 Niamh 老師！今天教你遇到生氣的客人時用的十二句話。
lines.cap: Hi everyone, I'm Niamh! Today: twelve sentences for when a customer is angry.

lines.say: You'll listen, apologise the smart way, offer a solution, and stay calm, even if they don't.
lines.zh: 傾聽、聰明地道歉、給出方案，而且就算對方不冷靜，你也要冷靜。

scenes.title: Listen
scenes.sub: 先傾聽：讓對方知道你懂

lines.say: Part one: listen.
lines.zh: 第一段：先傾聽。

lines.say: An angry person doesn't want an explanation first. They want to feel heard.
lines.zh: 生氣的人一開始不想聽解釋，他們想被理解。

scenes.label: No. 1
scenes.phrase: I can see why you're frustrated.
scenes.meaning: 我能理解你為什麼不高興

lines.say: I can see why you're frustrated.
Frustrated means annoyed because something isn't working.
lines.zh: frustrated 是因為事情不順而惱火。

lines.say: I can see why doesn't say you were wrong. It just says your feeling makes sense.
lines.zh: I can see why 不是承認你錯，只是說對方的感受合理。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I can see why you're frustrated.

scenes.label: No. 2
scenes.phrase: Twenty minutes is far too long to wait.
scenes.meaning: 等二十分鐘真的太久了

lines.say: Then repeat the problem in their words. It shows you were really listening.
lines.zh: 接著用對方的話把問題說一遍，證明你真的有在聽。

lines.say: Twenty minutes is far too long to wait.
Far too is stronger than too. You're agreeing with them, completely.
lines.zh: far too 比 too 更強，你完全站在對方那邊。

lines.say: It's very hard to keep shouting at someone who agrees with you.
lines.zh: 人很難一直對著同意自己的人大吼。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: Twenty minutes is far too long to wait.

scenes.label: No. 3
scenes.phrase: Let me make sure I've got this right.
scenes.meaning: 讓我確認一下我理解得對不對
scenes.note: get it right ＝ 理解正確

lines.say: If the story is long or messy, slow it down.
lines.zh: 如果對方講得又長又亂，就讓節奏慢下來。

lines.say: Let me make sure I've got this right.
Then you repeat what you heard, step by step.
lines.zh: 然後把你聽到的一步步覆述一次。

lines.say: This also gives the customer a moment to breathe. Angry people need that.
lines.zh: 這也給對方一點喘息的時間，生氣的人需要這個。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Let me make sure I've got this right.

scenes.title: Apologise well
scenes.sub: 聰明地道歉：負責但不認罪

lines.say: Part two: apologise well.
lines.zh: 第二段：聰明地道歉。

lines.say: There's a big difference between sorry and it's not my fault.
lines.zh: 「抱歉」和「不是我的錯」之間差很多。

lines.say: It's not my fault sounds like you don't care.
lines.zh: 「不是我的錯」聽起來像你不在乎。

lines.say: And saying sorry ten times sounds weak. One sorry, then action.
lines.zh: 一直說對不起聽起來很弱。說一次，然後行動。

scenes.label: No. 4
scenes.phrase: I'm really sorry about the wait. That's not the service we want to give.
scenes.meaning: 真的很抱歉讓你久等，這不是我們想提供的服務

lines.say: I'm really sorry about the wait. That's not the service we want to give.
You're sorry about the wait, not sorry that you exist. Be specific.
lines.zh: 你是為「等待」道歉，不是為自己道歉。要具體。

lines.say: And the second part shows you have standards. It's about the shop, not about you.
lines.zh: 後半句表示你們有標準，講的是店，不是你個人。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I'm really sorry about the wait. That's not the service we want to give.

scenes.label: No. 5
scenes.phrase: Our machine went down this morning, but that's no excuse.
scenes.meaning: 我們的機器今天早上壞了，但這不是藉口
scenes.note: go down ＝（機器）故障　no excuse ＝ 不是藉口

lines.say: You can give the reason, if you add one important part.
lines.zh: 你可以說原因，只要加上一個重要的部分。

lines.say: Our machine went down this morning, but that's no excuse.
Went down means stopped working.
lines.zh: went down 是故障、停擺。

lines.say: But that's no excuse changes everything. Now it's information, not a defence.
lines.zh: 加上 but that's no excuse，就變成說明，而不是辯解。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: Our machine went down this morning, but that's no excuse.

scenes.label: No. 6
scenes.phrase: I completely understand, and I'd feel the same.
scenes.meaning: 我完全理解，換作是我也會這樣覺得
scenes.note: I'd feel the same ＝ 我也會有同樣感受

lines.say: And if they keep going, stay with them.
lines.zh: 如果對方繼續抱怨，就繼續陪著他。

lines.say: I completely understand, and I'd feel the same.
I'd feel the same puts you on their side of the counter.
lines.zh: I'd feel the same 讓你站到櫃檯的同一邊。

lines.say: Use it once. More than once and it sounds like a script.
lines.zh: 說一次就好，說太多聽起來像在背台詞。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I completely understand, and I'd feel the same.
Let's try that again.
lines.zh: 我們重來一次。

lines.say: I've been waiting twenty minutes for one coffee!
lines.zh: 一杯咖啡我等了二十分鐘！

lines.say: I can see why you're frustrated. Twenty minutes is far too long to wait.
lines.zh: 我能理解你為什麼不高興，等二十分鐘真的太久了。

lines.say: It is! I have a meeting in ten minutes.
lines.zh: 就是啊！我十分鐘後要開會。

lines.say: I'm really sorry about the wait. Our machine went down this morning, but that's no excuse.
lines.zh: 真的很抱歉讓你久等。我們的機器今天早上壞了，但這不是藉口。

lines.say: OK. So what now?
lines.zh: 好吧，那現在怎麼辦？

lines.say: Listen to his voice. He's already calmer. Now he wants a solution.
lines.zh: 聽他的語氣，已經冷靜多了。現在他要的是解決方法。

lines.say: Part three: fix it.
lines.zh: 第三段：解決問題。

lines.say: Don't just say what you can't do. Say what you can.
lines.zh: 不要只說你做不到什麼，要說你能做什麼。

scenes.label: No. 7
scenes.phrase: Here's what I can do for you.
scenes.note: 最有力量的一句客服英文

lines.say: Here's what I can do for you.
This sentence moves the conversation from the problem to the solution.
lines.zh: 這句話把對話從問題帶到解決方法。

lines.say: Customers relax as soon as they hear it. Try it.
lines.zh: 客人一聽到這句就會放鬆。試試看。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Here's what I can do for you.

scenes.label: No. 8
scenes.phrase: I can either refund you, or get you a drink from next door.
scenes.meaning: 我可以退錢給你，或是去隔壁幫你買一杯
scenes.note: either A or B ＝ A 或 B 二選一

lines.say: Then give two options.
lines.zh: 接著給兩個選項。

lines.say: I can either refund you, or get you a drink from next door.
Either A or B gives the customer a choice. A choice gives them back control.
lines.zh: either A or B 讓客人自己選，選擇權讓人覺得被尊重。

lines.say: Even small options work, as long as they're real.
lines.zh: 選項小沒關係，只要是真的做得到。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: I can either refund you, or get you a drink from next door.

scenes.label: No. 9
scenes.phrase: I'll handle this myself, so you don't have to explain it again.
scenes.meaning: 我會親自處理，你不用再解釋一次

lines.say: And if it needs a manager, don't just pass them on.
lines.zh: 如果需要找經理，不要直接把客人丟過去。

lines.say: I'll handle this myself, so you don't have to explain it again.
Handle means take care of it, from start to finish.
lines.zh: handle 是從頭到尾負責處理。

lines.say: The worst thing for an angry customer is telling the whole story twice.
lines.zh: 對生氣的客人來說，最糟的就是同一件事要講兩次。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I'll handle this myself, so you don't have to explain it again.

scenes.title: Stay calm
scenes.sub: 對方太過分時：冷靜設界線

lines.say: Part four: stay calm.
lines.zh: 第四段：保持冷靜。

lines.say: Most customers calm down. But some start shouting, or getting personal. You have limits too.
lines.zh: 大多數客人會冷靜下來。但有些人會開始大吼或人身攻擊。你也有底線。

scenes.label: No. 10
scenes.phrase: I want to help you, but I need you to stop shouting.
scenes.meaning: 我想幫你，但請你不要再大吼了
scenes.note: I need you to ＝ 我需要你……（堅定）

lines.say: I want to help you, but I need you to stop shouting.
Start with I want to help you. Then the limit.
lines.zh: 先說「我想幫你」，再說底線。

lines.say: I need you to is firm, but not rude. Say it slowly and quietly.
lines.zh: I need you to 很堅定，但不無禮。慢慢地、小聲地說。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I want to help you, but I need you to stop shouting.

scenes.label: No. 11
scenes.phrase: Let me get my manager. She'll be able to help you further.
scenes.meaning: 我去請經理來，她能進一步幫你
scenes.note: help you further ＝ 進一步協助

lines.say: And when it's above your level, hand it over properly.
lines.zh: 超出你權限時，就好好地交接。

lines.say: Let me get my manager. She'll be able to help you further.
Further means more, beyond what I can do.
lines.zh: further 是更進一步，超出我能做的範圍。

lines.say: Then tell your manager the story, so the customer doesn't have to.
lines.zh: 然後你把經過告訴經理，客人就不用再講一次。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: Let me get my manager. She'll be able to help you further.

scenes.label: No. 12
scenes.phrase: Thanks for your patience. I hope we see you again.
scenes.meaning: 謝謝你的耐心，希望你再來

lines.say: And always end on a warm note, even if they weren't very patient!
lines.zh: 最後一定要溫暖地結束，就算對方其實沒什麼耐心！

lines.say: Thanks for your patience. I hope we see you again.
Thanking someone for patience they didn't really have is a small gift. They'll notice.
lines.zh: 感謝一個其實沒什麼耐心的人，是送他一份小禮物。他會感覺到。

lines.say: Often that angry customer becomes a regular.
lines.zh: 很多時候，那個生氣的客人最後變成了常客。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Thanks for your patience. I hope we see you again.
Here's what I can do for you. I can either refund you, or get you a drink from next door.
lines.zh: 我可以幫你這樣處理：退錢給你，或是去隔壁幫你買一杯。

lines.say: Next door is fine. I like their coffee anyway.
lines.zh: 隔壁就好，反正我也喜歡他們的咖啡。

lines.say: Ha! Fair enough. I'll be back in two minutes.
lines.zh: 哈！好吧。我兩分鐘後回來。

lines.say: Thanks. And sorry for shouting.
lines.zh: 謝謝。剛剛大吼不好意思。

lines.say: Thanks for your patience. I hope we see you again.
lines.zh: 謝謝你的耐心，希望你再來。

lines.say: He apologised to me! That's how you know it worked.
lines.zh: 他反過來跟我道歉！這就代表成功了。

scenes.title: Only in Ireland
scenes.sub: 愛爾蘭限定：形容生氣的兩種說法

lines.say: One more thing! Two Irish ways to talk about angry people.
lines.zh: 還有加碼！愛爾蘭人形容生氣的兩種說法。

lines.say: After a shift, you tell your friends about him like this.
lines.zh: 下班後跟朋友講這位客人，你會這樣說。

lines.say: He was raging.
Raging means extremely angry. In Ireland we use it all the time.
lines.zh: raging 是氣到不行，愛爾蘭人超常用。

lines.say: And when something goes wrong, and there's nothing you can do, Irish people say this.
lines.zh: 事情出錯又無能為力時，愛爾蘭人會這樣說。

lines.say: Ah, sure look.
It means: oh well, that's life, let's move on. It's the most Irish sentence there is.
lines.zh: 意思是：唉，人生就是這樣，往前走吧。這是最愛爾蘭的一句話。

lines.say: Ah, sure look!

scenes.title: All together
scenes.sub: 總複習：從一顆星到常客

lines.say: Let's go back to that first customer. Say my lines with me!
lines.zh: 我們回到那位客人。跟我一起唸！

lines.say: I've been waiting twenty minutes for one coffee! This is ridiculous!
lines.zh: 一杯咖啡我等了二十分鐘！太誇張了吧！

lines.say: I can see why you're frustrated. Let me make sure I've got this right. You ordered a flat white?
lines.zh: 我能理解你為什麼不高興。讓我確認一下，你點的是 flat white？

lines.say: Yes. Twenty minutes ago.
lines.zh: 對，二十分鐘前。

lines.say: I'm really sorry about the wait. That's not the service we want to give.
lines.zh: 真的很抱歉讓你久等，這不是我們想提供的服務。

lines.say: OK. Thank you for saying that.
lines.zh: 好，謝謝你這樣說。

lines.say: Here's what I can do for you.
lines.zh: 我可以幫你這樣處理。

items: I can see why you're frustrated.
Twenty minutes is far too long to wait.
Let me make sure I've got this right.
I'm really sorry about the wait. That's not the service we want to give.
Our machine went down this morning, but that's no excuse.
I completely understand, and I'd feel the same.
Here's what I can do for you.
I can either refund you, or get you a drink from next door.
I'll handle this myself, so you don't have to explain it again.
I want to help you, but I need you to stop shouting.
Let me get my manager. She'll be able to help you further.
Thanks for your patience. I hope we see you again.

lines.say: From raging to regular. Brilliant work!
lines.zh: 從氣炸到常客。做得太好了！

lines.say: Here are all twelve. Take a screenshot before your next shift.
lines.zh: 十二句都在這裡，下次上班前先截圖。

lines.say: Before you go! Do you want to practise English a little every day?
lines.zh: 走之前！想每天都練一點英文嗎？

lines.say: Try BinBin. Every day, there's a short news story from where you live, with the hard words explained.
lines.zh: 試試 BinBin。每天一則你所在地區的短新聞，難的單字都有解釋。

lines.say: Then play quick word games, on your own or with your friends.
lines.zh: 接著玩快速的單字小遊戲，自己玩或約朋友一起。

lines.say: Keep your streak going, unlock new titles, and say hi to other learners in the plaza.
lines.zh: 保持連續打卡、解鎖新稱號，還能在廣場跟其他學習者打招呼。

lines.say: And there are more lessons like this one, right inside the app.
lines.zh: App 裡還有更多像這樣的英文小教室。

lines.zh: 上 binbindaily.com，或點下面的連結。
lines.cap: Go to binbindaily.com, or tap the link below.

lines.say: And if today was hard? Ah, sure look. See you next time. Bye!
lines.zh: 今天很辛苦？唉，算了啦。下一課見，Bye！
